blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Procurement is the job of buying everything the company needs. This means raw materials, parts, equipment and services. It sounds simple, but doing it well saves a lot of money.

A good buyer checks three things: price, quality and reliability. The cheapest supplier is not always the best. A supplier who is cheap but always late can cost more than you saved.

The job is to find the right mix: a fair price, good quality, and delivery you can trust.

items.q: What is procurement?
options: The job of hiring new staff
The job of buying what the company needs
The job of paying the workers
items.why: "Procurement is the job of buying everything the company needs."

items.q: What three things does a good buyer check?
items.why: "A good buyer checks three things: price, quality and reliability."

items.q: Is the cheapest supplier always the best?
items.why: "The cheapest supplier is not always the best."

items.q: The text suggests that a cheap supplier who is always late…
options: can cost you more money in the end
items.why: Inferência: "can cost more than you saved" — o atraso apaga a economia do preço baixo.

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: You should be able to trust the delivery.
A fair price matters, but so does quality.
Always pick the supplier with the lowest price.
Good buying saves the company money.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo diz que o mais barato não é sempre o melhor — o preço mais baixo não deve decidir sozinho.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver treinando um novo comprador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. I am happy you are here. Today I want to tell you a short story about last year, because it teaches an important lesson.

We had a supplier for many years. Their price was very low, and everyone liked that. But there was a problem. They were often late. Sometimes the parts came two weeks late, and the factory had to stop and wait. When a factory stops, it loses a lot of money.

So we looked for a new supplier. The new one was a little more expensive. At first, some people said no — why pay more? But I said, "Let's think about the full cost, not just the price."

The new supplier was never late. The quality was good, and we could trust every delivery. In the end, we saved money, because the factory never stopped.

So here is my advice for you. When you buy, don't look only at the price. You should check quality and delivery too. A fair price with good service is always better than a cheap price with big problems.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What was the problem with the old supplier?
items.why: "But there was a problem. They were often late."

items.q: What happened when the parts came late?
options: The factory had to stop and wait
items.why: "the factory had to stop and wait."

items.q: What was different about the new supplier?
options: It was far but very cheap
It was a little more expensive but never late
items.why: "The new one was a little more expensive... The new supplier was never late."

items.q: Why does Oliver say they saved money in the end?
options: Because the new price was the lowest
Because they paid the supplier later
items.why: Inferência: "we saved money, because the factory never stopped" — parar a fábrica custava mais do que o preço mais baixo economizava.

items.q: What does Oliver want the new buyer to learn?
options: Look at quality and delivery, not only price
items.why: Inferência: "don't look only at the price. You should check quality and delivery too."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our procurement team buys parts for the whole factory." Procurement means…
items.why: Procurement = compras: o setor que compra o que a empresa precisa.

items.q: "We work with only one supplier for glass." A supplier is a company that…
items.why: Supplier = fornecedor: quem nos fornece produtos ou peças.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The parts came on time every week. This supplier has great ___."
items.why: Reliability = confiabilidade: entregar sempre no prazo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This price is not too high and not too low. It is a ___ price."
items.why: Fair = justo: um preço equilibrado, nem alto demais nem baixo demais.

items.q: "The truck brought the boxes to the door." This is the delivery. Delivery means…
items.why: Delivery = entrega: trazer os produtos até você.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de compras. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the new supplier." Sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new supplier in every factory." Roll out means to…
options: start using it, step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar, colocar em uso de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two buyers pushed back on the higher price." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "The supplier promised to fix the delay, but never followed through." They…
options: did not do what they promised
items.why: Follow through = cumprir, levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Let's shop around before we choose a supplier." Shop around means to…
items.why: Shop around = pesquisar e comparar várias opções antes de decidir.
